description:
My Property Box are delighted to offer to the student lettings market this three bedroom ground floor flat situated on Valley View, Jesmond.

Finished to a high standard, this upmarket property is always popular with groups of three looking for a modern and spacious flat whilst still being close to the heart of Jesmond. Ideally located near popular student streets such as Cavendish Place and Devonshire Place, the property has recently undergone extensive refurbishment works. The accommodation briefly comprises three double bedrooms, a central bathroom, a spacious kitchen, and a private rear yard with garage access.

Contact My Property Box today to arrange a viewing!
